PROPER - a proper synth for house music (Windows)
https://github.com/VouDoo/proper-synth

What's in here
  Proper.exe    the standalone app
  Proper.clap   the CLAP plugin
  Proper.vst3   the VST3 plugin

Plugins
  Copy them into the standard plugin folders, then rescan in your DAW:
    Proper.clap  ->  C:\Program Files\Common Files\CLAP\
    Proper.vst3  ->  C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\
  (Create the folder if it doesn't exist. Windows will ask for admin
  rights.)

Standalone app
  Double-click Proper.exe. To pick your MIDI keyboard, run it from a
  terminal: Proper.exe --midi-input ""  lists the devices, then
  Proper.exe --midi-input "<your keyboard>"  plays through it.

"Windows protected your PC"?
  These builds aren't signed, so SmartScreen warns about them. Click
  "More info", then "Run anyway".

Licence
  Proper's source code is MIT-licensed (see LICENSE). These compiled builds
  include GPLv3-licensed code (nih-plug's VST3 bindings), so the builds are
  shared under the GPLv3 (see LICENSE-GPL-3.0.txt). The full source is at
  the address above.
